## Summary

- Navitas Life Sciences, Cybersecurity Intern (Feb–Aug 2026): led a SOC detection audit across CrowdStrike NG-SIEM, FireEye, Microsoft Purview DLP and Netskope mapped to MITRE ATT&CK; designed and built a self-hosted AI alert-triage system (SecureBERT 2.0 + LoRA classifier with a Foundation-Sec-8B LLM judge and plain-language explanations) to cut false positives.
- Wipro, Project Engineer, Azure & Microsoft Entra (Mar 2022–Jul 2024): least-privilege enforcement and access reviews in Entra ID, Conditional Access and O365 security rollout for a large enterprise.
- Projects: Cloud SIEM with hybrid ML attack detection (Azure, Zeek, Isolation Forest + Random Forest, MITRE ATT&CK dashboards); malware analysis and development research (C, Python, isolated VMs).
- Measured results and figures are in the resume (/resume.pdf).
- Certifications: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals; Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals; Certified SAFe 6 Agilist; SC-500: Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate (in progress).
